newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey PM to meet coalition ally Ciller on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Turkey PM to meet coalition ally Ciller on Friday.

text.p: Turkey's Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan was to meet his coalition partner Tansu Ciller on Friday afternoon amid a row over religious activism that has threatened the future of the government, a Ciller aide said.
The aide, who declined to be named, said the two would meet at 2.30 p.m. (1130 GMT) at the prime ministry.
Deputy Prime Minister Ciller earlier denied a press report she would pull her True Path Party (DYP) out of the alliance with Erbakan.

The Yeni Yuzyil daily quoted unnamed cabinet ministers as saying Ciller, also the foreign minister, planned to withdraw the DYP from the 10-month-old government over a growing dispute between the Islamists and the army.
Members of Ciller's conservative wing are concerned at the failure of Erbakan, the country's first Islamist leader, to implement an anti-Islamist crackdown demanded by the powerful army in February.
Erbakan will face the generals at a meeting of the National Security Council on Saturday that has been billed as a showdown.
